text:
Ellery & Vane has acquired world English-language rights to *The Glass Cartographer* for a reported $425,000 advance, the publisher confirmed on 14 March 2025.

The deal rests on a signed rights agreement, announced in a joint press statement issued at the Halvorsen Book Fair. Marguerite Odell, acquisitions director at Ellery & Vane, negotiated the terms.

Key numbers:

- Advance: $425,000 (reported)
- Rights: world English-language
- Status: signed, confirmed 14 March 2025

The joint statement signals both sides were ready to close publicly at the fair, where rights trading tends to cluster.

What it means for the sector: a six-figure advance for a single title shows independent-scale houses remain willing to compete on price for standout properties. Rival acquisitions teams will be watching how Ellery & Vane positions the book, and whether the figure resets expectations for comparable titles.
